name: bench_vortex_zed_multiview
description: A multiview vision dataset captured with ZED-style cameras intended to evaluate multi-view computer-vision tasks such as 3D reconstruction, depth estimation, and pose estimation. It provides synchronized multiview imagery for algorithms that reconstruct geometry or estimate camera/object poses from multiple viewpoints.
reputation: A niche dataset used in multiview/robotics vision research with limited but focused adoption among practitioners working on stereo and multi-view reconstruction.
